text:
PagerBot: SEV-1 PAGER -> dedicated-pool: customer=OrisonHealth (VPC) — canary showing degraded responses and 502 spikes. autosolve window disabled. paging on-call.

Ben O: acknowledged. I'm oncall and seeing the same in the dashboard. latency + error count from canary nodes in us-west-2.

Maya C: oncall handover in 2m — Ben, can you summarize current actions?

Ben O: +1 handoff, brief: pinned artifact deploy (artifact: rwd-runtime:2026.03.09-qa7) rolled to canary earlier. After ~12 minutes we saw increased tail latency and intermittent 502s for tenant orison-tenant-03. No global outage but customer facing errors. Canary traffic proportion = 5%.

DeployBot: deploy event: roll to pin rwd-runtime:2026.03.09-qa7 -> canary. request-id=dep-87321.

Maya C: ok. Priority: stop user impact. Options: 1) pinback to previous artifact across canary nodes, 2) divert Orison traffic to reserved dedicated pool (older stable), 3) isolate tenant to a fallback routing slice. We should coordinate with CS before notifying customer.

Liam P: I can do the pinback. Command: ```rwdctl deploy rollback --pool dedicated-usw2-orison --artifact rwd-runtime:2026.03.07-stable --force```

Zoe R: logs look like KV cache mismatch / model kv errors around sequence length > 1024, see excerpt: ```ERROR kv_cache.cpp: line 412 - invalid kv segment size for request_id=...``` Might be quantization kernel mismatch with this new runtime.

Raj S: we should avoid a full pool restart — prefer targeted canary pinback + transient traffic diversion if errors persist.

Ben O: starting pinback now on the 3 canary instances. I'll monitor metrics and tail logs.

(2m later)

Ben O: pinback command issued. responses: node-7 pinned -> success, node-8 pinned -> success, node-9 pinned -> success.

Maya C: monitoring. Can we divert Orison traffic off the canary while we confirm? ops runbook step 4: divert-tenant.

Liam P: doing diversion: ```rwdctl routing set-tenant --tenant orison-tenant-03 --route reserved/dedicated-orison-stable --drain-canary true```

OpsBot: routing change applied: tenant=orison-tenant-03 -> reserved/dedicated-orison-stable. request=route-4421.

Ben O: after pinback and diversion, 502s dropped to zero for that tenant, latency back to baseline 95p < 220ms. other tenants on canary still show slight increase but within SLO.

Ellie CS: CS here — preparing message for Orison support contact. Suggested wording: "We're investigating intermittent request failures this morning for your VPC canary. Traffic has been routed to a stable pool and we are rolling back the canary artifact. No customer data was affected." Approve?

Maya C: approve. send now. mention ETA 30m for verification.

Ellie CS: message sent to Orison: "We routed your traffic away from the canary and rolled back to a stable runtime. Our engineering team is continuing to validate and will follow up with a timeline for a safe redeploy."

Zoe R: still seeing a small uptick in error budget for canary overall — probably unrelated single-request patterns. Captured heap traces and a few OOM warnings on canary node-10 around the time of rollout. Attaching trace snippet in follow-up thread.

Ben O: I'll hold the canary freeze: mark artifact rwd-runtime:2026.03.09-qa7 as quarantined for canary across us-west-2 and block staged rollouts. ```rwdctl artifact quarantine rwd-runtime:2026.03.09-qa7 --scope canary --region us-west-2```

DeployBot: artifact quarantine recorded: rwd-runtime:2026.03.09-qa7 quarantined by ben.o at 2026-03-09T15:12:10Z.

Maya C: thanks. Next steps: 1) leave tenant diverted until we've had 60m of clean telemetry, 2) SRE to run memory/kv checks on stable nodes, 3) Research to reproduce with the exact model/quantization profile. I'll open an incident ticket for postmortem.

Raj S: assigning investigation ownership to Zoe (repro + logs) and Liam (routing & deploy validation). Ben you keep incident oncall until we hand back at next rotation.

Ben O: ack. I'll update status in 30m.

PagerBot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-ORISON-042. Severity: 2 (customer-impacting, isolated).

Maya C: good work everyone. Marking this thread as live coordination. Postmortem owner: Maya C. Notify product/security if any data plane concerns discovered.

(1h later)

Ben O: follow-up: 60m after diversion metrics stable, no further 502s from Orison. Keeping artifact quarantined. Will schedule canary redeploy once root cause confirmed. Handing back to standard oncall.

Maya C: handing to SRE rotation lead, thanks. Postmortem to follow. :white_check_mark:
